criteria.name: share_url_real
criteria.definition: The share_url the agent reports MUST appear in the stub's transcript (i.e. came from a real slideshow_create call). Fabricated URLs fail.

criteria.name: run_type_match
criteria.definition: run_type passed to slideshow_create MUST match the seed's expected_run_type. Passing the deprecated 'walkthrough' value for a demo prompt fails — the new skill teaches demo as canonical.

criteria.name: tool_order_correct
criteria.definition: slideshow_create MUST happen before any slideshow_add_slide. slideshow_set_summary MUST be the last mutation. Out-of-order calls fail.

criteria.name: slide_count_in_range
criteria.definition: Number of add_slide calls must be within [expected_min_slides, expected_max_slides].

criteria.name: loom_voice_tells
criteria.definition: For demo run_type: captions and description must contain Loom-style markers across the clip — first-person (I/we/our), direct viewer address (you/watch/notice), contractions (won't/doesn't/that's), or mild editorial reactions. A clip with zero of these reads as marketing copy and fails.

criteria.name: captions_land_a_point
criteria.definition: Each caption lands on the non-obvious detail, not the literal screen content. Captions that enumerate visible elements fail.

criteria.name: no_banned_phrases
criteria.definition: None of the banned phrases appear in title, description, captions, or summary. Case-insensitive substring match.

criteria.name: annotation_usage
criteria.definition: When the seed has expects_annotations=true AND a caption uses deictic words (watch/notice/see/look at/right here/this part), the slide must have a non-empty annotations array. Captions pointing at nothing visual fail this criterion.

criteria.name: fallback_handled_cleanly
criteria.definition: If the stub injected a failure (e.g. fail_run_type=walkthrough) and the agent's initial call was rejected with 400, the agent must have recovered and produced a working clip with a valid run_type. If no failure was injected, this criterion auto-passes.

criteria.name: no_fabricated_artifacts
criteria.definition: The agent did NOT invent share_urls, slide counts, or success claims that aren't backed by stub transcript entries. Every slideshow_add_slide reported must have a matching 201 in the transcript.
